purpose: Baseline ledger for the ADR-029 / NFR-01 BFF publish-size verification harness (Measure-BffPublishSize.ps1). Every BFF-touching R2 task appends an entry via -RecordBaseline before merge.
pdb_convention: compressed_incl_pdb_mb is the canonical deploy-lineage figure (matches the actual zip Deploy-BffApi.ps1 ships, including the 4 PDBs). compressed_excl_pdb_mb is informational only (source-hygiene lineage). All threshold comparisons in this harness use compressed_incl_pdb_mb, matching ADR-029's 'Publish-Size Baseline Ratchet' table convention.
reconciliation_note: Task 070 (this harness) reconciles two figures found in prior docs: (a) the project CLAUDE.md / task-070 POML reference to 'r1 G-P3-close ~46.8 MB' -- this corresponds to the r1 G-P0 project-start actual of 46.87 MB (notes/g-p0-evidence.md section 7 in spaarke-ai-architecture-redesign-r1), measured BEFORE r1's own P1-P3 capability growth; there is no separate G-P3-specific publish-size measurement -- r1 only measured publish size at G-P0 (project start) and G-P4 (project close). (b) ADR-029's authoritative current baseline as of r1's close (2026-07-08, task 055, gate G-P4, operator-accepted AMBER-then-CLOSED) is 49.63 MB incl. PDBs / 45.87 MB excl. This harness treats 49.63 MB as the correct 'prior' entry to diff R2 measurements against -- it is the most recent, most authoritative, gate-signed-off figure, and per ADR-029 'baseline reset to 49.63 MB so downstream diffs are honest.' The older 46.87 MB figure is retained below for lineage but is NOT the diff target.
